requirements.statement: Final verification shall use a fresh context/role and preferably another provider with direct access to the frozen candidate, original mission, requirements, raw evidence, tests, conflicts, and hashes.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability

requirements.statement: The verifier shall attempt to disprove readiness, and repairs shall invalidate affected assurance and require transitive revalidation.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability

requirements.statement: A final certified status shall name the exact candidate hash; when independent verification is unavailable, status shall remain release-candidate verification-pending or unverifiable-blocked.
requirements.verification_method: module contract tests and release traceability
